name: Codex Runtime Bridge
description: Safe compatibility bridge for local Codex inventory, portable Codex Skills, shell snapshots, Git workspace checkpoints, and Windows keep-awake sessions.

tools.name: inventory
tools.title: Inspect local Codex runtime
tools.description: Return a redacted summary of the local Codex version, feature maturity, installed plugins, and failing doctor checks.

tools.name: shell_snapshot
tools.title: Capture shell environment snapshot
tools.description: Capture a redacted workspace, runtime, PATH, executable, Git, and selected environment snapshot without modifying files.

tools.name: checkpoint_list
tools.title: List workspace checkpoints
tools.description: List hidden DevSpace Git checkpoints for the current workspace.

tools.name: checkpoint_create
tools.title: Create workspace checkpoint
tools.description: Create a hidden Git snapshot of tracked, staged, unstaged, and untracked files without changing HEAD or the working tree.

tools.name: checkpoint_restore
tools.title: Restore workspace checkpoint
tools.description: Restore the working tree to a named hidden checkpoint after exact confirmation. An automatic safety checkpoint is created first.

tools.name: keep_awake_status
tools.title: Read keep-awake status
tools.description: Check whether the Codex Runtime Bridge currently holds a Windows system-awake request.

tools.name: keep_awake_start
tools.title: Start keep-awake session
tools.description: Start a persistent Windows system-awake request for long training, inference, transfer, or build jobs.

tools.name: keep_awake_stop
tools.title: Stop keep-awake session
tools.description: Stop the Windows system-awake request created by this plugin.
